newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada 1997/98 budget to be presented Feb 18.
newsitem.headline: Canada 1997/98 budget to be presented Feb 18.

text.p: Canadian Finance Minister Paul Martin said on Monday he will present the government's budget for the 1997/98 fiscal year starting April 1 on February 18.
"The budget will be tabled in this House on Tuesday, the 18th of February, at 4:30 in the afternoon (2130 GMT)," Martin told parliament.
Martin told reporters later that the government was well ahead of its budget targets and that Canada was well into an economic recovery.

Martin normally follows the practice of announcing two-year rolling targets for budget deficits. In October he announced the target of C$9 billion or one percent of gross domestic product for the 1998/99 fiscal year.
Some analysts expect him to announce a balanced budget goal for 1999/2000, although that would give a target for a third year.
